bullets.text: GPA 9.64/10, top of class. High-school valedictorian. English C1.
Built Execution OS solo in 2 months: an MCP server exposing an executive operation as agent-callable tools with scoped permissions per tool, plus 30 mini apps and LLM pipelines.
Built an OCR and LLM pipeline turning image and PDF orders into structured data, cutting transcription errors 80–90% and halving token cost per order.
Migrated legacy 4D systems to Java and Spring Boot for the second largest private bank in Argentina and an automotive lender, working on production paths that move customer funds.
Built an agentic testing pipeline into the CI/CD flow that automated 4D-to-web conversion and cut manual migration effort roughly 40%, catching regressions before release.
Wrote COBOL Batch and Online programs on a core banking mainframe (CICS, JCL) under change control, production systems settling real transactions nightly. IBM Z Xplore certified.

Built a gateway that governs employee AI use: every prompt is checked against company policy before it leaves the network, secrets are masked and every decision is written to a tamper-evident audit log.
Ran the enforcement model on-device (QVAC) so prompts and secrets never reach a third-party API, removing the data-exfiltration path that AI adoption normally opens.
Shipped signed macOS and Windows builds days after the hackathon; demo requests from companies followed and launch is in preparation.
